validation.whatItDoesNotProve: The dry run proves wiring only; live command requires real deployment inputs.
validation.failureHandling: Juniper repairs orchestration and reruns.
validation.blockerPolicy: Live lifecycle closure is required for COMPLETE but is not a local prepush hard fail.

validation.name: Release lifecycle discoverability contract
validation.productionRisk: A new operator could miss required lifecycle or cleanup commands.
validation.whatItProves: Package, updater contract, README, authority index, and lifecycle runbook stay aligned.
validation.whatItDoesNotProve: Does not execute deployed lifecycle stages.
validation.failureHandling: Juniper repairs command/document wiring before release handoff.
validation.blockerPolicy: Strong warning; blocks lifecycle handoff quality, not application build.

validation.name: Canonical West Peek brand system
validation.productionRisk: Cross-suite visual identity drifts or generic SaaS colors displace the West Peek brand.
validation.whatItProves: Canonical #F05A1A token, restrained orange rule, and brand authority exist.
validation.whatItDoesNotProve: Does not replace route-complete Hallmark visual review.
validation.failureHandling: Repair before Hallmark approval and COMPLETE status.
validation.ownerDecisionNeeded: NO unless changing canonical brand authority.
validation.blockerPolicy: Strong warning; required before Hallmark approval and COMPLETE status, but not a compile hard-fail.

validation.name: Baseline packaging contract
validation.productionRisk: Updater-ready baseline may omit required executable inputs or include forbidden generated/runtime files.
validation.whatItProves: Required root files and repo-specific packaging prerequisites exist; forbidden local/generated paths are absent.
validation.whatItDoesNotProve: Does not prove runtime behavior, browser behavior, deployment, or live providers.
validation.failureHandling: Repair the source artifact and repackage before updater execution.
validation.blockerPolicy: Blocks artifact delivery and updater execution.

validation.name: Baseline artifact-mode packaging contract
validation.productionRisk: Final ZIP staging tree could contain forbidden generated/runtime files if artifact mode is skipped.
validation.whatItProves: Final artifact staging tree has required files and excludes forbidden generated/runtime paths.
validation.whatItDoesNotProve: Runtime, browser, deployment, or provider behavior.
validation.failureHandling: Run during packaging; repair artifact before delivery.
validation.blockerPolicy: Blocks packaging only when explicitly executed.

validation.name: Registration continuity: lifetime, second device, no privilege on an unverified email
validation.productionRisk: A guest who registered on a laptop opens the link on a phone mid-show, meets a blank form, and reads the product as broken; or the fix for that becomes a hole where any typed address inherits VIP and stage-publishing rights.
validation.whatItProves: The session lifetime is named and per-event and the copy reads the resolved value; the same-email return path is rate-limited and silent about who is registered; the restored session is stamped and every privileged read checks the stamp.
validation.whatItDoesNotProve: Does not prove runtime behaviour; tests/unit/registrationContinuity.test.ts covers restore, refusal, healing, expiry and enumeration.
validation.failureHandling: Repair source, rerun, and revalidate before push.
validation.blockerPolicy: Blocks delivery or push.

tierPolicy.tier1: Static/source/contract proof only. Does not prove browser, deployed runtime, or live providers.
tierPolicy.tier2: Local runtime/browser/self-spawn proof. Does not prove deployed runtime or live providers.
tierPolicy.tier3: Deployed postdeploy critical proof and safe provider boundary against explicit deployed URL. Does not prove real live provider operations.
tierPolicy.tier4: Final real live-provider operational proof with real credentials, operator evidence, provider resource/state proof, no-secret evidence scan, and cleanup/retention record.

zeroWarningPolicy.rule: No validator may emit advisory noise as a default pass state. Diagnostic checks must be INFO / NO VALIDATION or HARD FAIL when risk is real.
zeroWarningPolicy.reason: Warnings create operator noise and unclear release authority. Every validator must have explicit owner, tier, proof layer, and blocker policy.
